issue.title: Checkout returns 500 for every customer since the 14:05 deploy
issue.description:
Since today's 14:05 deploy every POST /api/checkout answers 500. No order has gone through for 25 minutes and support has 40 open chats.

Logs: `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'currency')` in api/src/checkout/price.ts.

Rolling back the deploy is the fastest fix; the root cause still needs a patch and a test.
